title: Has anyone seen a underground spa/ pool room in the mall world?
content: Again the AI was not fitting exactly right but after multiple try’s this was the closest I got , the under pool room is under the mall for me you have to go down a winding stair case to get there.there’s many little pools to the sides of the room (it’s a circular room initially but then square out as the room go deeper, the main pool almost looks like one of those beach pools , the walls are either pink or white but the room has a ton of infrared lights as well as regular white bright lights on the ceilings and walls (almost like the whole room has made fake sunlight with the lights) there are smaller stairs as you go deeper into the room leading down to the main pool, they had futuristic lawn chairs/ lounge chairs that seemed almost metal but soft, the were silver and metallic, they also had red on them. I’m never in here that long . There are other people in the room usually a lady on one of the lounge chairs that will try to start a conversation (I don’t remember what she says but it makes me feel uneasy talking to her she’s in a black bathing suite, dark glasses a drink in hand and dark hair with bangs) I feel calm walking into the room until interacting with her.
